title: Navigation app-visible recovery
objective: Recover the existing Navigation accessibility product delta from legacy PR #2509 onto current main, preserve provider-backed data as provider data, and require exact-head app runtime and accessibility acceptance before integration.

recovery.additionalTruthHardening: Non-empty query changes clear prior MapKit results and enter searching state before the 300ms debounce so stale provider results cannot be presented under the new query.
recovery.accessibilityHardening: Both the floating Navigation launch control and selected-destination map overlay honor Reduce Transparency with solid system-background fallbacks; launch animation honors Reduce Motion; Accessibility Dynamic Type gets labeled launch geometry and map recomposition.

runtimeRepair.finding: XCResult proves the real native MapKit XCUI Map rendered at about 390x390 and the truthful empty state was visible; iOS 27 dropped SwiftUI navigation.map accessibilityIdentifier through the MapKit bridge, so the UI test locator—not the product map—failed.
runtimeRepair.repairScope: NembraUITests/NembraUITests.swift only; assert app.maps.firstMatch plus real geometry and visible truth-copy.

legacy.knownExactHeadFinding: Legacy #2509 is historical input only. #2831 current-main recovery is not accepted because its exact-head UI run failed on a platform-dropped MapKit identifier; #2865 is the evidence-driven locator repair and must earn fresh exact-head runtime proof.
